prompt: Revise this six-character lineup into REFINED JAPANESE ANIME JRPG concept art with MODERATE detail. Current designs are TOO BABY-CHIBI and too simplistic. Preserve six identities, silhouettes, distinct palettes and 3-column 2-row arrangement, full body and all appendages entirely within cells, transparent background. Aim halfway between simple cartoon and detailed fantasy illustration: elegant thin-to-medium dark contour, controlled fine structural lines, clean two-tone cel shadows plus small selective highlights. Add anatomical structure, cloth folds, seams, leaf veins and modest material detail, NOT dense hatching or busy repeated foliage. NOT western mascot cartoon, NOT toddler proportions, NOT photoreal, NOT gritty. Refine forms and slightly lengthen limbs and bodies, reduce oversized heads/hands/feet, expressive anime eyes. Top-left poison flower: graceful long curved stalk, refined overlapping purple trumpet petals, few delicate veins, two leaf arms, articulated root feet, threatening ivory fangs. Top-middle russet thorn boar: leaner mature quadruped, distinct shoulder/hip muscles and upper/lower legs, small fur tufts at cheek and back, three mossy thorn plates, fierce narrow anime eyes, ivory tusks. Top-right vine mage: 5-head humanoid in fitted deep-teal cloak, layered folded collar, pale carved wooden mask, one lime vine belt, simple leather wrist wraps, seed orb staff. Bottom-left flytrap: elegant segmented neck, hinged lime jaw leaves with six ivory teeth, salmon mouth, leaf hands with 2-3 veins and root feet; less round squat. Bottom-middle orange mushroom fighter: cute but older adventure-character rather than baby, slimmer cream stem torso, longer articulated arms and legs, refined oval eyes, small brown scarf and two leather wrist bands, orange cap with three cream spots and subtle gill detail. Bottom-right seedpod gunner: slim upright plant shooter, smaller pod muzzle, focused expressive eyes, three green pod segments on torso, articulated leaf arms and legs, folded-leaf crest, subtle seam/vein detailing. Give each face character and polished professional anime RPG finish. No smiles in combat, no text, no scenic background, no ambient haze.
